captureMethod: Logged-in Chrome session visible-DOM scrape, user-authorized, sanitized. No cookies, no tokens, no scripts, no styles, no forms, no submitted source code, no username, no timestamp, no language, no memory, no code length, no user-link, no problem text. Only the page title, the unique first-party problem anchor `/problem/P1001`, and the semantic verdict row keyed by the exact label 评测状态 with the sibling colored span containing `Accepted` are retained. The exact selector provenance is the semantic extractor `extractLuoguRecordRowText`: a leaf whose trimmed textContent is exactly 评测状态, surrounded by an enclosing div/li/tr/section row, with the full row text used for verdict classification. No body scanning, no generated data-v attribute. Source URL and record ID are public and retained.
purpose: detectVerdictFromDocument — verdict captured via the semantic extractor keyed by 评测状态. detectProblemFromPage — record-page problem identity via the unique `/problem/P1001` anchor.
